task_definition.task_name: Continuous DAS Data Filtering and Downsampling

task_description.overview: Apply a sequence of processing steps—low-pass filtering, time and space downsampling, then time integration—to continuous seismic data while preserving continuity across file boundaries.
steps: Initialize a Collection with continuous data file paths.
Define a list of operations: first a downsampling operation with time interval, spatial interval, and low-pass filter enabled; then a time integration operation.
Invoke the Collection.process method with the operations list, specifying an output directory and filename suffix.
Process each file sequentially, caching filter states to avoid discontinuities, and save processed data files to the target directory.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Using daspy package to initialize a Collection (from daspy import Collection). Apply the following processing sequence: downsampling with parameters {operations[0].parameters}, then time integration. Save the processed files under {savepath} with suffix {suffix}. Reload and plot a figure to show the raw and processed data. Save the result data to {result_data} and the result figure to {result_figure}.
